summary: Ansible 12 amazon.aws breaking changes: ansible-core<2.17 support dropped, and the EC2_ACCESS_KEY, EC2_REGION, EC2_SECRET_KEY, EC2_SECURITY_TOKEN/AWS_SECURITY_TOKEN and EC2_URL/S3_URL environment variables are removed in favour of AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, AWS_REGION, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY, AWS_SESSION_TOKEN and AWS_URL.
questions: Why is EC2_REGION no longer working?
Which ansible-core does amazon.aws need in Ansible 12?

answer_card.title: amazon.aws: renamed environment variables
answer_card.answer_md:
Removed in Ansible 12 (amazon.aws), with replacements:

| Removed | Use instead |
|---|---|
| `EC2_ACCESS_KEY` | `AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID` or `access_key` |
| `EC2_SECRET_KEY` | `AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY` or `secret_key` |
| `EC2_REGION` | `AWS_REGION` or `region` |
| `EC2_SECURITY_TOKEN`, `AWS_SECURITY_TOKEN` | `AWS_SESSION_TOKEN` or `session_token` |
| `EC2_URL`, `S3_URL` | `AWS_URL` or `endpoint_url` |
